title: RetireOPD: Self-Retiring On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Multi-turn agents trained with reinforcement learning (RL) receive a single scalar reward per trajectory, which motivates self on-policy distillation (OPD) to supply dense token-level supervision from a self-teacher with privileged task skills, letting a skill-free student internalize them. This recipe, however, is undermined by two findings in agentic tasks: privileged information alone does not always make a teacher reliable, and the benefit of teacher supervision is stage-dependent. We therefore propose RetireOPD (Self-Retiring On-Policy Distillation), which first optimizes a decoupled, skill-conditioned teacher with environment rewards and then trains a skill-free student jointly with RL and OPD. Rather than following a predefined distillation schedule, RetireOPD adopts Adaptive Retirement: the student drops the teacher on its own once their discrepancy stops shrinking and it reaches a target fraction of the teacher's success rate, after which training proceeds with RL alone. Across Qwen2.5 models from 1.5B to 7B, RetireOPD improves ALFWorld success rate over RL baseline by 14.1% to 18.8% and WebShop accuracy by 11.8% to 19.0%, and surpasses its own skill-conditioned teacher in every setting.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Welcome to Advanced Topics in Agentic AI. Today's lecture is on “RetireOPD: Self-Retiring On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning,” a recent paper from researchers at Zhejiang University and Alibaba Group. We've seen a lot of work in this space, like “Self-Distilled Reasoner” and “SEED,” that uses on-policy distillation to provide dense, token-level supervision for agents. This paper fits into that trend but asks a critical question: should that supervision last forever? It challenges the assumption that a teacher's guidance is uniformly beneficial throughout training. Yes, Noah?
segments.zh: 欢迎来到智能体AI进阶专题。今天这节课讲的是“RetireOPD：面向智能体强化学习的自退役同策略蒸馏”，这是浙江大学和阿里巴巴集团的研究人员最近发表的一篇论文。我们在这个领域已经看到很多工作了，比如“Self-Distilled Reasoner”和“SEED”，它们用同策略蒸馏来给智能体提供密集的、token级别的监督。这篇论文属于这个趋势，但它提出了一个关键问题：这种监督应该一直持续下去吗？它挑战了一个假设，就是老师的指导在整个训练过程中都是均匀有益的。好，Noah？

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Excuse me, Professor. You mentioned on-policy distillation. Can you quickly recap the core problem it's trying to solve?
segments.zh: 不好意思，教授。您刚才提到了同策略蒸馏。能简单回顾一下它想解决的核心问题是什么吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Of course. The fundamental challenge is credit assignment in long-horizon tasks. An LLM agent might interact with an environment for dozens of steps, but only receive a single reward—success or failure—at the very end. Reinforcement learning struggles with this because it's hard to know which of the hundreds of tokens generated were actually helpful. On-policy distillation, or OPD, tries to fix this by introducing a 'teacher' model. This teacher has access to privileged information, like a pre-computed solution or a list of required skills, and it provides token-by-token guidance to the 'student' agent, which doesn't have that extra info.
segments.zh: 当然。最根本的挑战在于长时程任务中的信用分配问题。一个LLM智能体可能与环境交互几十步，但只在最后收到一个奖励——成功或失败。强化学习很难处理这种情况，因为很难知道生成的几百个token里到底哪些是有用的。同策略蒸馏，也就是OPD，试图通过引入一个“教师”模型来解决这个问题。这个教师模型可以获取一些特权信息，比如预先算好的解答或者所需技能的列表，然后它会给“学生”智能体提供逐token的指导，而学生智能体并没有这些额外信息。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So the teacher provides a dense reward signal.
segments.zh: 所以老师模型提供的是密集的奖励信号。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Exactly. Instead of just a final outcome, the student gets feedback on every single step. However, the RetireOPD paper identifies two key flaws in this common approach. First, just giving a model privileged information doesn't automatically make it a competent teacher. It might not know how to use that information effectively to succeed at the task. Second, even a great teacher can become a crutch. Early in training, imitating the teacher is beneficial. But later on, the student might discover novel, even better strategies. If it's still forced to match the teacher, its performance can be limited.
segments.zh: 没错。学生模型不是只拿到一个最终结果，而是每一步都能得到反馈。不过，RetireOPD这篇论文指出了这种常见做法中的两个关键缺陷。第一，仅仅给模型提供特权信息，并不能自动让它成为一个称职的老师。它可能并不知道如何有效利用这些信息来完成任务。第二，即使是很厉害的老师，也可能变成拐杖。训练早期，模仿老师是有益的。但到了后期，学生可能会发现更新颖、甚至更好的策略。如果这时还强迫它去对齐老师，它的表现就会受限。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Wait, so is the teacher a completely separate, more powerful model?
segments.zh: 等等，那老师是一个完全独立、更强大的模型吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That's a great question. In this case, the teacher and student start from the same base model. But crucially, RetireOPD's method separates their training. It proposes a three-stage pipeline. First is Privileged Teacher Construction. They take the teacher model and train it independently on the environment using the privileged information. They use an RL algorithm called GRPO to ensure the teacher actually becomes proficient at the task. Only after it's competent do they freeze its weights. This addresses the first problem of assuming the teacher is inherently good.
segments.zh: 这是个好问题。在这个情况下，教师和学生是从同一个基础模型出发的。但关键在于，RetireOPD 的方法把它们的训练分开了。它提出了一个三阶段的流程。第一阶段是特权教师构建。他们把教师模型拿出来，用特权信息在环境中独立训练它。他们用一种叫 GRPO 的强化学习算法来确保教师确实变得擅长这个任务。只有在它变得足够胜任之后，他们才冻结它的权重。这就解决了第一个问题，也就是不能假设教师天生就是好的。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: And the second stage is training the student?
segments.zh: 那第二阶段就是训练学生了？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Correct. In the second stage, they do joint training. The student, which has no access to the privileged skills, learns from two signals simultaneously. It gets the sparse, trajectory-level reward from the environment, optimized with GRPO. At the same time, it gets the dense, token-level distillation loss, which encourages it to match the frozen teacher's predictions. This is the classic OPD setup, but with a teacher that's been explicitly verified as competent.
segments.zh: 没错。在第二阶段，他们做的是联合训练。学生模型没法接触到那些特权技能，它同时从两个信号里学习。一个是来自环境的稀疏的、轨迹级别的奖励，用GRPO来优化。同时，它还会收到稠密的、token级别的蒸馏损失，这个损失促使它去匹配那个冻结的教师模型的预测。这就是经典的OPD设置，只不过这里的教师模型已经被明确验证过是合格的了。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Okay, that brings us to the core idea. How does it know when to 'retire' the teacher? Is it just a fixed schedule?
segments.zh: 好，这就说到核心了。它怎么知道什么时候该让老师“退休”？是固定时间表吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That's the main contribution. Instead of a fixed schedule, the retirement is adaptive. They monitor two signals during training. The first is alignment stagnation. They measure the difference between the teacher's and student's token predictions. If this gap stops shrinking or starts growing, it suggests the student has learned all it can from the teacher, or their strategies are beginning to diverge. The second signal is relative competence. They check if the student's success rate on the task is close to the teacher's, say, at least 90 percent. When both conditions are met—the student isn't getting any closer to the teacher and is already almost as good—the distillation is 'retired.'
segments.zh: 这就是主要贡献。它用的不是固定时间表，而是自适应地让老师退休。训练过程中他们监控两个信号。第一个是对齐停滞。他们测量老师和学生在token预测上的差异。如果这个差距不再缩小，甚至开始变大，就说明学生已经从老师那里学到了能学的全部，或者两者的策略开始分化。第二个信号是相对能力。他们检查学生在任务上的成功率是否接近老师，比如至少达到90%。当这两个条件同时满足——学生不再向老师靠拢，而且已经几乎一样好——蒸馏就“退休”了。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: And then it just continues with standard reinforcement learning?
segments.zh: 然后它就继续用标准的强化学习来训练吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Precisely. The OPD loss term is dropped, they stop running the teacher model, and the student finishes training using only the environment rewards. The results on benchmarks like ALFWorld and WebShop are quite compelling. The student model consistently ends up outperforming not only the baseline RL agent but also its own teacher, which supports the idea that the teacher's guidance eventually becomes a constraint.
segments.zh: 没错。OPD损失项被去掉，他们不再运行教师模型，学生模型仅靠环境奖励完成训练。在ALFWorld和WebShop这类基准上的结果相当有说服力。学生模型最终不仅稳定超过基线强化学习智能体，还超过了自己的教师模型，这也印证了教师模型的指导最终会变成一种约束。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: This work shifts the perspective on distillation. Instead of viewing it as a continuous process of knowledge transfer, it frames it as temporary scaffolding. You use the teacher for dense guidance to bootstrap the student's learning, but you remove it to allow for task-specific optimization and exploration once the student is capable enough. This aligns with a broader idea that different learning signals are valuable at different phases of training. Imitation is useful early on, but eventually, the agent needs to be grounded in the true task objective.
segments.zh: 这项工作转变了对蒸馏的看法。它不再把蒸馏视为一个持续的知识迁移过程，而是把它当作一种临时脚手架。你用教师模型提供密集指导来启动学生的学习，但一旦学生足够有能力，就移除教师，以便进行针对具体任务的优化和探索。这与一个更广泛的观点一致：不同的学习信号在训练的不同阶段各有价值。模仿在早期有用，但最终，智能体需要扎根于真实的任务目标。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: This approach of first ensuring teacher competence and then dynamically removing the teacher... it seems like a response to some critiques we've seen. For instance, the paper 'Does On-Policy Distillation Really Distill?' highlighted that teacher supervision can be noisy. Is this a way to mitigate that?
segments.zh: 这种先确保教师有能力、再动态移除教师的做法……看起来像是对我们见过的一些批评的回应。比如那篇《On-Policy Distillation Really Distill？》就指出，教师的监督可能是有噪声的。这是不是一种缓解这个问题的办法？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That's an excellent connection. Yes, you can see it as a direct answer to that family of problems. By pre-training the teacher on the task reward, they explicitly reduce the noise and ensure the guidance is effective. And by retiring it, they prevent the student from overfitting to any remaining imperfections or suboptimal strategies from that teacher. It avoids the performance ceiling that a persistent, imperfect teacher might impose, allowing the student to surpass it by focusing purely on the environment reward.
segments.zh: 这个联系非常好。是的，你可以把它看作是对这一类问题的直接回应。通过在任务奖励上预训练教师，他们明确地降低了噪声，确保指导是有效的。而通过让教师退役，他们防止了学生过拟合教师身上残留的缺陷或次优策略。这避免了持续存在但不完美的教师可能带来的性能天花板，让学生能够纯粹聚焦于环境奖励，从而超越教师。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: So, the key takeaway from RetireOPD is that in agentic training, the lifecycle of supervision matters. The focus is shifting from just using privileged information to using it intelligently. This means ensuring your source of guidance is actually competent at the task and, critically, knowing when to let the student learn on its own. It's a move toward more adaptive, dynamic training regimes that are responsive to the agent's learning progress. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 所以，RetireOPD 的关键结论是：在智能体训练中，监督信号的生命周期很重要。重点正在从单纯使用特权信息，转向智能地使用它。这意味着要确保你的指导来源确实能胜任这个任务，而且更关键的是，要知道什么时候该让学生自己学。这是朝着更自适应、更动态的训练机制迈进，能够对智能体的学习进展做出响应。感谢收听。如果还有任何问题，可以问我们的 AI 助手，或者留言评论。
